name: Error-summary
purpose: Boxed summary of form errors placed at top of page, focused on page load. 5px error border; bold title; list of error links that move focus to each field.

roles: container with role=alert OR tabindex=-1 + focus on load; links list
accessibility.focus: container receives focus on load (tabindex=-1); links get yellow-fill focus style
accessibility.notes: error links use aria-describedby targets' ids; title is an h2

antiPatterns: listing errors without linking to fields
summary without moving focus to it
